independence: Reviewer-authored deterministic source replay plus separate manual full primary review; did not author target or use author replay as scientific proof.
review_kind: Initial independent scientific review, not author validation

manual_edge_assessment.assessment: Each chemical side, coefficient, charge and stereochemical identifier independently replayed against full Rhea142 RDF and ChEBI. All four balances and net balance pass.

Native three complexes and their exact monomers/accessions establish DeoD6, Hpt4 and Gpt4. Function and condition-specific evidence distinguish physiological route from uniform flux. Add is a functional protein catalyst without an invented oligomer.

Cofactors, localizations and strain scope independently read in current original UniProt and nearest primary evidence. Add Zn is HAMAP ECO0000255 inference; Hpt Mg curated ECO0000305; Gpt Mg experimental ECO0000269. GO localization does not imply exclusive pathway compartment. Edge029 IMP product inhibition is retained from reviewed Hpt activity-regulation annotation with experimental attribution; no cellular effect size is inferred.
All four native membership/layout/direction and native Rhea cross-reference bridges independently replayed against exact master directionalReaction/bidirectionalReaction triples.

Intended shared chemical intermediates are correct in independent Rhea replay. Native pathway evidence overattributes ChEBI IDs to PWY-6609 XML, which has native frame names only: confirmed minor finding issue351.

primary_inspection.extent: Full seven-page original PDF; independently reproduced text and rendered/visually inspected pages1 and3; Fig1, Table1, enzyme assays, Table2 and Fig3 read. K12 genetic derivatives and conditional adenine utilization support the full route; no MG1655-wide constitutive flux claim.
primary_inspection.reproduction_command: UV_CACHE_DIR=/private/tmp/pathwaymech-curation-uv-cache uv run --offline --no-project --with pypdfium2 --with pillow python; PdfDocument, get_textpage/get_text_range, render(scale=1.6).to_pil()

primary_inspection.extent: Full original BioC XML; passage40 homohexamer and passage63 recombinant construct/ligand conditions independently read. Supports assembly, not native flux.

Original indexed abstracts individually read; distinctions among Hpt/Gpt substrate preference, tetramer vs historical apparent trimer, Add complementation and DeoD hexamer retained. Hpt full text unavailable, not claimed inspected.
Metadata only, no primary abstract available; experimental statements are attributed to inspected database annotations rather than an invented direct full-paper review.

selected_gene.uniprot_function: Catalyzes the hydrolytic deamination of adenosine and 2-deoxyadenosine

imodulondb_independent_check.interpretation: Computational expression context only. Broad add/hpt/gpp search substring hits are not biochemical proof; no module absence conclusion. Canonical console availability and direct unchanged-client fallback are retained in shared receipts.

limitations: Reviewer authored separate galactonate record, not this target. Source replay and primary assessment here were independently performed.
No full text claimed for sources available only as indexed abstracts. Annotation-derived Add Zn and Hpt Mg grades remain explicit.
Initial open issue351 requires source-separated native and Rhea evidence. Required shared full-corpus checks are recorded in the immutable review only after actual terminal outcomes.
No browser surface; graph check is actual KGX/source parity, not browser visual QA.
